policy.whole_scope: One fixed monotonic deadline after local request/host/duration/TLS configuration preflight, spanning DNS/TCP, TLS handshake, request write, full response line, and best-effort close-notify.
policy.step_scope: A fresh step allowance clamped to the fixed whole-send deadline. Activity never renews the whole budget; the entire response line shares one read step deadline.
policy.zero_or_overflow: Zero whole budget refuses before I/O; zero step budget returns Timeout(connect). Unrepresentable durations return InvalidTimeout(scope) before timers. Pure invalid-request, zero and overflow cases are polled without a runtime.
policy.expiry: Named existing Timeout(step) remains distinct from WholeSendTimeout. Whole expiry after a complete parsed reply during cleanup retains Some(exact native SendReceipt). No receipt means delivery may be unknown after transmission.
policy.cleanup: Step-only close failure remains best effort and returns the known receipt. A primary fingerprint mismatch survives either cleanup deadline without any application request write.
policy.framing: Complete CRLF required within the native 2048-byte response limit. Exact fit accepted; EOF, bare LF and a capped partial line cannot become an acknowledgement. Status/META/fingerprint representation and the general status parser remain unchanged.
policy.cancellation: Dropping the send future drops its owned connection; no detached cleanup or resend. A dropped future cannot return a reply already received. Deadlines are cooperative and cannot preempt a blocking carrier poll; late ready completions are refused.
policy.send_authority: Explicit native or Errand send call only; ordinary fetch refuses Misfin. No retries, redirect-following or automatic resends.

actual_localhost_tcp_tls: Stalled TLS distinguishes step vs whole timeout and peer observes transport close.
Delayed handshake plus reply exhausts one cumulative budget after exactly one request.
Dripping response cannot renew the whole-send allowance.
Cancellation after peer observes the request closes transport without duplicate data or another connection.
Fingerprint mismatch preserves expected/found facts and sends no application request.
20/30/31/40 native statuses, META and server fingerprint are retained without redirects or retry.
Stalled native response preserves existing response-read step timeout.
controlled_carrier_and_paused_time: Individually valid steps exceed the single cumulative whole budget.
Partial request write distinguishes step and whole expiry.
Pending shutdown after 20/40 reply retains exact receipt on whole expiry.
Step-only pending/error shutdown retains best-effort successful receipt.
Pending shutdown after fingerprint refusal preserves primary error and writes nothing.
Exact response byte cap, EOF, bare LF and overlong framing.
Always-ready operation crossing the whole deadline cannot return success.
adapter_and_cli: Errand exact native receipt mapping and distinction from step timeout.
Default options defer to native policies; zero step and whole options refuse before contact.
Existing helper delegates to explicit options helper; ordinary fetch rejects mail.
CLI error output retains native status display, META and server fingerprint.
coverage.limits: Real tokio-rustls shutdown does not wait for peer close-notify; pending cleanup expiry is qualified at the shared private AsyncWrite seam rather than falsely claimed as a native peer-stall result. Localhost fixtures do not qualify external DNS, remote mailservers, delivery reconciliation, receiving deadlines, headed product UI, radio, or independent-machine behavior.

consumer_boundary: Misfin owns sending semantics. Errand forwards independently selected mail budgets via misfin_send_with_options/MisfinSendOptions and preserves typed native timeout receipts. CLI inherits defaults and retains known receipt fields on error. Mere's mail adapter is receive-only; this supplier-native slice requires no product repin or sending UI.
